General Mills is seeking an E-Commerce Packaging Engineer in their Pet Segment Operating Unit. You will serve as the direct Packaging R&D business interface across these key brands to deliver the current plan and partner on growth strategies, and build packaging capability to enable the future growth for Pet. This role will create and translate a Packaging modeling framework to help accelerate our flexible format across all of Pet with an emphasis on e-commerce. This responsibility spans across a large raw material cost of goods sold and requires strong activation and leadership to deliver against innovation and cost savings goals.

You will manage a portfolio of products through a complex manufacturing network, temperature states, and channels, providing opportunities to lead new ways of working with a variety of cross-functional partners.

• Bachelor's Degree in Packaging Engineering or other related degree fields

• 5 years of packaging experience working in CPG packaging or other relevant industry, with 3+ years working on e-commerce packaging.

• Experience and technical acumen across a variety of packaging materials, including flexible films and thermal rigid plastics.

• Demonstrated strong people skills, strategic planning, and leadership skills

• Desire to challenge assumptions, identify new opportunities, and create new ways of working & capabilities.

• Effective communication skills to influence internal and external stakeholders

• Takes accountability to win, has a bias for action, and can deliver results through others.

• Depth and experience in designing, qualifying, and commercializing dry pet food packaging across an array of size offerings for all channels.

• Mentoring and coaching others for growth.

• Experience in mentoring and developing other packaging engineers or team members.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and organizational complexity.

• Demonstrated strong agile leadership & ability to pivot quickly.

• Exceptional multi-tasking, follow-up, and prioritization skills.

jobs.description:
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering is looking for a System Development Engineer (SysDE) to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team. Our mission is to eliminate operational complexity at the source, ensuring every RDPI automation solution is designed for deployability, reliability, and maintainability from Day One.

As a SysDE III on the NPI team, you will embed with Hardware Development programs from the Alpha phase to influence controls and system architecture *before* solutions are built. Rather than fixing deployment and reliability problems in the field, you will design them out, shaping the automation, firmware, and integration decisions that determine how easily a solution scales across our global network. You are a technical leader who owns the controls architecture of the systems you support, decomposes ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, and partners with Hardware Development, Technical Program Managers, and the Scale and AI teams to deliver solutions that deploy themselves and run with minimal human intervention.

Key job responsibilities
- Embed with NPI programs from Alpha through GA, influencing controls and system architecture for deployability, reliability, and maintainability.
- Design standardized hardware/software interfaces and modular, reusable control patterns that reduce integration complexity across solutions.
- Build and validate automation and commissioning frameworks (CI/CD for controls code, automated configuration validation, emulators) in partnership with the Scale team.
- Lead reviews of architecture, design, and operations for your solutions, and contribute to reviews of partner-team systems.
- Partner with Hardware Development, TPMs, and the AI team to incorporate self-service deployment and predictive capabilities into solutions from inception.
- Mentor engineers, set engineering and operational excellence standards for the team, and contribute to the Operational Planning (OP) process.

A day in the life
You work across industrial control platforms (Codesys, Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff) and the networked field devices, firmware, and cloud/WMS interfaces. You architect the controls software for a new solution, design reusable control patterns and contribute it to our libraries, write and review structured-text and automation-tooling code, and partner with Hardware to shape a system before it's built. Lead design reviews that surface architectural and scalability risks early, and prototype frameworks, emulators, automated validation, CI/CD for controls code that become the foundation future solutions are built on. You build and engineer solutions that are correct by design.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Description:

Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Digital Operations and Manufacturing Automation team is seeking a Sr. Manager, Logistics and Packaging Process Owner to lead the convergence of physical automation, embodied artificial intelligence, and advanced robotics for automated packaging solutions across diverse manufacturing network.

This role will serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) bridging plant-floor packaging, intralogistics, and Physical AI across diverse manufacturing environments including bottles, vials, cell culture products, consumables, and other manufactured components. You will partner closely with global teams, R&D, Engineering, Operations, PPI and Automation teams to standardize processes, eliminate waste, improve material flow, optimize packaging operations and accelerate automation transformation.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in packaging automation with a forward-looking passion for Physical AI, including edge-vision models, autonomous robotics, digital twins, and AI-driven material handling.

You will work closely with the sites to transition legacy manual operations into adaptive, autonomous, and self-optimizing packaging lines.

Key Responsibilities

Process Ownership & Strategy

• Work with manufacturing sites to evaluate manual packaging operations and identify opportunities to reduce labor, improve safety and ergonomics, increase productivity, and improve process consistency.
• Develop automation concepts for processes including product handling, bagging, pouching, sealing, cartoning, labeling, shrink wrapping, case packing, conveying, inspection, and palletizing.
• Evaluate applications for robotics, cobots, machine vision, flexible feeding, conveyors, automated material handling, and other packaging technologies.
• Develop solutions capable of accommodating multiple products, package formats, production volumes, and changeover requirements.

Technical Execution & Integration

• Support the sites in technical requirements, User Requirement Specifications (URS), and equipment design for primary/secondary packaging equipment, robotic palletizing, labeling, vision verification systems, and material movement (AGVs, AMRs, conveyors).
• Collaborate with IT/OT and engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between shop-floor automation, MES, WMS, and ERP systems.
• Scope work, evaluate proposals, and manage Tier-1 automation vendors, OEMs, and system integrators from design through FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing), SAT, and commissioning.
• Ensure suppliers clearly understand Thermo Fisher requirements for functionality, product handling, cycle time, process capability, quality, safety, documentation, validation, and schedule.
• Participate in supplier selection, design reviews, equipment testing, FAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ, installation, commissioning, and production ramp-up

Compliance, Quality & Safety

• Ensure all packaging processes and equipment designs adhere to relevant regulatory standards (FDA, GMP, ISO, OSHA/OHSA safety compliance, and machine safety guarding).
• Facilitate technical discussions between suppliers and global Thermo Fisher teams, ensuring engineering intent, technical issues, decisions, and actions are clearly understood.
• Establish quality verification checkpoints (e.g., automated vision inspection, barcode/serialization tracking, dynamic checkweighers) to eliminate packaging errors.

Change Management & Governance

• Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to simplify and optimize processes before introducing automation.
• Help develop reusable equipment concepts, supplier capabilities, standards, and best practices that can be deployed across multiple Thermo Fisher locations.
• Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), line operation training programs, and operational readiness playbooks for local plant engineering and operations teams.
• Manage operational metrics (OEE, scrap rates, downtime, throughput) for packaging and logistics processes, reporting performance metrics to executive leadership.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field
• 8+ years of proven ability in packaging automation, manufacturing automation, automated equipment development, or a related engineering field.
• Demonstrated experience developing or implementing automated packaging equipment and systems.
• Experience taking automation projects from initial concept and specification through design, fabrication, FAT, installation, and production qualification.
• Hands-on experience troubleshooting automated equipment and resolving technical problems.

Technical Skills

Experience with several of the following technologies:

• Automated bagging and pouching
• Cartoning and case packing
• Labeling and product identification
• Robotic pick-and-place
• Conveying and product handling
• Palletizing and end-of-line automation

Travel Requirements

• Travel to Thermo Fisher manufacturing and engineering sites in Americas and EMEA will be required to evaluate existing processes, understand product and manufacturing requirements, and support equipment implementation.
• Expected travel 30%, with periods of increased travel during site assessments, equipment builds, FAT, installation, and qualification.

Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .

Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Packaging Engineer with over 5 years of experience in the design and development of film- and paper-based flexible packaging solutions. This role demands deep technical knowledge of paper substrates, coatings, and sustainable barrier technologies, combined with strategic leadership to drive innovation, cost optimization, and environmental stewardship. The successful candidate will serve as a subject matter expert, collaborating closely with R&D, marketing, sales teams, and customers to deliver high-performance, sustainable paper-based packaging that meets regulatory and market requirements. This position sits within Eastman’s technology organization and provides support for our Coatings business organization.

The position reports through the Group Leader Coatings Applications Development, located in Kingsport, TN, USA and is part of a global team.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship on packaging properties, converting processes (e.g., lamination, metallization, printing, filling, sealing), performance testing and application requirements specific to film and paper-based solutions.
• Lead customer facing projects regarding the design, development, and optimization of paper-based flexible packaging structures, including multi-layer laminates incorporating paper substrates, coatings, and sustainable barrier materials.
